spec: FR-2.14, task 004 stage 7. What an exercise's history charts plot, per session: the top load, the best e1RM, the volume and the counted sets — each over the counted sets only (INV-04). Deload sets are charted normally (INV-08 keeps them out of records, not out of history). A value with nothing to measure is null, never 0: a blank RIR leaves the e1RM null (INV-03, INV-07), and a session with no counted set carrying a load and reps has no volume.
expectation_shape: `expected` holds one entry per session, in order. `best_e1rm` is not a float: it is the load and effective rep count of the set that holds it, or null, so each consumer applies Epley in its own arithmetic, exactly as e1rm.json does. `top_load_kg` and `volume_kg` are exact sums and products and are written out.

cases.name: a warm-up is in the log and out of every metric, however heavy
a blank RIR is a gap in the e1RM, never a zero, and costs nothing else
the best e1RM is the best set's, not the heaviest set's
a deload session is charted normally
a session with nothing measurable has no numbers, one per session all the same
a bodyweight session is measured on total load, lifter included (FR-2.15a)
cases.note: The second session has no body weight logged by its date, so it has no load at all (INV-07) — and still counted.
